prompts.leak_audit_notes: This prompt tests a basic RSI mean-reversion strategy on SPY at daily resolution. Key LEAN-specific failure modes include: (1) incorrect RSI period — the prompt says '10-day RSI' so the model must use period=10, not the default 14; (2) forgetting to warm up the RSI indicator before trading begins, which can cause premature signals on the first few bars; (3) using self.RSI() shorthand vs. manual indicator registration with RegisterIndicator(); (4) not checking IsReady before acting on indicator values; (5) ambiguity around whether to hold a full position or partial — the prompt says 'buy' and 'sell' without specifying quantity, so the model must make a reasonable assumption (e.g., SetHoldings or a fixed share count). The exit condition (RSI > 70) only triggers if already long, which requires position-state awareness. Minor variation is expected around order sizing and whether to use MarketOrder vs. SetHoldings.
prompts.original_text: Buy SPY when 10-day RSI drops below 30, sell when RSI rises above 70. Daily resolution.
